html:
Blender alpha.5 sidebar redesign — October 16, 2026

The Blender add-on advances to 0.2.35-alpha.5 and restyles its native 3D Viewport ForgeMCP sidebar around the supplied reference. A logo/version card and Bridge Status card sit above a grouped Send to Unreal panel. The panels expose the current bridge state, loopback endpoint, session, last authenticated request, auto-start option, ForgeMCP path, optional Unreal session, asset path, save/place options, placement coordinates and transfer status/preview.

The existing native Blender controls, local authenticated bridge, exact source-name behavior, /Game/Content/Returns/ default and reviewed preview/confirm/cancel workflow remain in use. No scene objects, preferences, or project files were changed. Blender numeric metadata remains (0, 2, 35).

Validation on Blender 5.2.2 LTS:

  • The headless sidebar draw probe registers the add-on, exercises both panel draw methods, checks the visible sections and transfer properties, and confirms the default asset path while the startup scene remains unchanged.
  • Source branding verification passed.
  • The alpha.5 ZIP passed the existing clean-profile install and layered native add-on acceptance suite.
  • The updated user add-on was installed at %APPDATA%\Blender Foundation\Blender\5.2\scripts\addons\majestic_forge; installed __init__.py, transfer_ui.py and logo bytes match the source hashes.
  • A fresh headless Blender process imported, registered and unregistered the installed add-on and reported alpha.5.
  • No interactive Blender window was open, so final visual review of spacing and colors in the live sidebar remains unverified.
